title: Transposable Elements Contribute to Activation of Maize Genes in Response to Abiotic Stress
genotypes: B73; Mo17; Oh43 (cold tolerance not stated)
growth_system: soil (1:1 autoclaved field soil and MetroMix); grown at 24 C under natural light, July 2013; light conditions the same for all stress and control conditions; location and chamber for the cold treatment NR
other_factors: same control also used for heat (50 C, 4 h), high salt (300 mM NaCl watering, 20 h before collection) and UV-B (2 h); genotype
timepoints_duration: single time point (16 h cold); tissue collected at 9 am
bio_reps: 3 for control, cold and heat in B73 and Mo17; 1 for salt and UV in B73 and Mo17; 1 per condition in Oh43 (including cold); each replicate pooled plants (8 per the RNA section of Methods; 6 per the growth section)
n_libraries: 27 (computed from Methods: B73 11, Mo17 11, Oh43 5; not stated in text)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000, TruSeq libraries (University of Minnesota Genomics Center); 10-20 M reads per sample; read length and SE/PE NR
other_omics: none (TE insertion calling used public genomic reads; qRT-PCR validation)
key_finding: Stress-responsive genes, including cold-induced ones, are enriched for nearby insertions of specific TE families; cold, heat, salt and UV profiled in three inbreds.
source_of_details: PMC full text (Methods) + PMC page data availability statement
notes: PubMed abstract does not mention cold (so missed by title/abstract searches). A PLoS Genet correction (PMC4599801) replaced the supplementary SRA sample table because the original SRA accession numbers listed were incorrect; use the corrected table. Oh43 and salt/UV are unreplicated. Possible data overlap with Waters2017 (PMID 28188666, in PubMed list): check. Used as one of the stress datasets in Hoopes 2019 (Plant J, DOI 10.1111/tpj.14184). bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/008052.

title: Multi-omic analysis of maize NILs for chilling tolerance QTLs uncover regulatory and metabolic signatures
genotypes: two near-isogenic lines (NILs) differing at two major chilling-tolerance QTLs on chromosome 4 (one chilling-tolerant; names NR); 5.15 Mb divergence region
tissue: NR (abstract says organ-resolved; organs not read)
cold_treatments: 14 C day / 10 C night for 20 days
